items.t: Steering suddenly feels heavy or sticky (recall)
items.job: Replace steering gear spring and regrease gear

items.t: Plug-in hybrid can shut down while driving (recall)
Loss of drive power from engine software (recall)
Loss of power in EV mode from inverter software (recall)
Engine may not restart after auto stop (recall)
items.job: Reprogram powertrain and battery control computers

items.t: Defroster, seat belt chime or 360 camera may not work (recall)
Automatic emergency braking can brake for no reason (recall)
Steering and suspension bolts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten or replace steering and suspension bolts

items.t: Backup camera image may not appear (recall)
Pedestrian warning sound may be wrong (recall)
Hybrid System Malfunction warning with power loss
items.job: Diagnose hybrid system and apply software updates
items.note: Should be covered by the hybrid and new-vehicle warranties; out of warranty, parts could add a lot.

items.t: Jerky or harsh shifting at low speed
items.job: Check and update transmission and powertrain software
items.note: Covered under warranty on these model years.

items.t: Front brakes squeal at low speed
items.note: Dealers may do this under warranty on a new vehicle.

items.t: Center screen goes black, reboots or CarPlay drops
items.job: Update Mazda Connect software by USB
items.note: Bulletin labor is 0.3 hours and is covered under warranty.

items.t: Dead 12-volt battery and stuck in Park
items.job: Test charging system and replace 12-volt battery
